eyebrow: From curated files to business tables

steps.label: Redshift Spectrum
steps.sub: queries the curated S3 data straight through the Glue Data Catalog

steps.label: installation_performance_gold
steps.sub: daily kWh total and a panel-health flag per installation

steps.label: monthly_billing_gold
steps.sub: total kWh and the net-metering credit per billing month

code:
INSERT INTO gold.installation_performance_gold
SELECT installation_id,
  CAST(reading_timestamp AS DATE) AS performance_date,
  SUM(kwh_generated) AS kwh_total,
  CASE WHEN ... THEN 'FAULT' ... END AS panel_health_flag
FROM caldera_spectrum.inverter_events_clean
GROUP BY installation_id, CAST(reading_timestamp AS DATE);
caption: Spectrum reads the curated Parquet directly -- no second copy of the data to keep in sync.

code:
-- Board-approved net-metering rate: $0.1125/kWh
INSERT INTO gold.monthly_billing_gold
SELECT installation_id,
  DATE_TRUNC('month', performance_date)::DATE AS billing_month,
  SUM(kwh_total) AS total_kwh,
  ROUND(SUM(kwh_total) * 0.1125, 2) AS net_metering_credit_amount
FROM gold.installation_performance_gold
GROUP BY installation_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', performance_date);
caption: One documented rate, applied the same way for every member, every month.

subtitle: Running the whole thing automatically, every night.
